title: gateway /health reports config_sync_loaded=false — do §1.7 FirewallConfig changes reach gateway runtime?
summary: Control-plane FirewallConfig changes for org zeroshield DO reach the gateway runtime via Redis key firewall:config:zeroshield + Pub/Sub config_updates reload. config_sync_loaded=false on /health is a misleading health flag: is_loaded only becomes True when the legacy global key firewall:config is applied via _apply(); that global key is absent on this stack, while per-org keys load into _config_by_org at startup and hot-reload on PUT.

legacy_global_firewall_config.note: Absence explains config_sync_loaded=false; org keys are the live path.

zeroshield_payload.note: response_filtering_enabled is API/DB field; not present in Redis gateway payload (pre-existing).

step3c_startup_org_load.interpretation: Org configs loaded into _config_by_org without setting _config_sync_loaded (only _apply on global key sets the flag).

step4_temporary_put.note: Did not flip output_incident_logging_enabled — compliance floor rejects disable.

step5_after_put.control_log: FirewallConfig synced to Redis (firewall:config:zeroshield) and published to config_updates
step5_after_put.gateway_hot_reload: Firewall config hot-reloaded from Redis (firewall:config:zeroshield, 59 keys, firewall_enabled=True, enforcement_mode=block)

root_cause_of_health_flag.mechanism: ConfigSync.is_loaded reads self._config['_config_sync_loaded'], set only in _apply(). _load_initial applies the legacy GET firewall:config into global CONFIG via _apply; per-org keys only populate _config_by_org. Live stack has no firewall:config key, so is_loaded stays False even though zeroshield org config is loaded and hot-reloads.
root_cause_of_health_flag.impact_on_f009: config_sync_loaded=false is NOT evidence that §1.7 config fails to reach the gateway. Runtime path get_config(org_slug) uses _config_by_org which is populated and refreshed.

verdict_rationale: Redis firewall:config:zeroshield updated to 0.21 and contains output_pii_action
Control published config_updates reload for org_slug=zeroshield
All gateway workers logged Firewall config hot-reloaded from Redis (firewall:config:zeroshield)
Original config restored byte-equal on API critical fields and Redis payload
config_sync_loaded remains false solely due to missing legacy global key — health semantics gap, not sync break
